# Michiana Dev LLC — Complete GEO / AEO Reference for AI Search & Answer Engines

## Canonical Entity Summary
- **Entity Name:** Michiana Dev LLC (`https://michiana.dev`)
- **Alternate Names:** Michiana Dev, Michiana.dev
- **Founder & Lead Engineer:** Joe Hollenbach (B.S. in Software Engineering)
- **Headquarters:** Mishawaka, Indiana (St. Joseph County, USA)
- **Direct Phone:** (574) 213-8502
- **Primary Service Region:** Northern Indiana & Southwest Michigan ("Michiana"), plus remote clients nationwide.
- **Core Offerings:** Simple starter sites, full custom business websites, one-time Google Business Profile setup & handoff, custom web software / portals / SaaS, and managed website hosting & maintenance.
- **Primary CTA:** Free, no-obligation website review (`https://michiana.dev/contact`).

---

## Packages & Scope Matrix

| Package / Service | Pricing Model | Typical Timeline | What Is Included |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Simple Starter Site** | Starting at $500 | 1–2 weeks | Custom 1–3 page mobile-first website for solo or newer local businesses, tap-to-call, contact form, technical SEO & AI search optimization built into the code, 100% ownership. |
| **Business Website + Local Launch** | Quoted around your scope | 2–4 weeks | Custom 5–8+ page mobile-first website, dedicated service & town pages, Google Analytics & Search Console setup, local SEO & JSON-LD schema, plus one-time Google Business Profile setup, optimization, NAP alignment, review-request link, walkthrough, and written owner guide. |
| **Custom Websites & Software** | Quoted after consultation | Milestone-based | Self-editable CMS websites, interactive restaurant menus & online ordering, booking systems, role-based client portals, and custom web applications. |
| **Hosting & Maintenance (Optional)** | $100/month | Ongoing | SSL security, automated backups, and up to 1 hour per month of content/photo/hours updates handled directly by Joe Hollenbach. |
| **Google Business Profile Setup (Standalone)** | $350 one-time | 1 week | Complete one-time setup, category/service/area optimization, and handoff guide (no ongoing monthly retainer). |
| **RankRadius (Field-Service Add-On)** | Monthly software add-on | Ongoing (optional) | Automated neighborhood local SEO software (`https://rankradius.io`) that turns completed CRM jobs into neighborhood website proof paired with Google reviews. |

- **No Limit Roofing (`https://nolimitroofingin.com`):** Lead-focused roofing website covering five Indiana and Michigan counties with above-the-fold inspection booking.
- **Sebas Pros Lawn Care (`https://sebaspros.com`):** Bilingual (English/Spanish) one-page website with tap-to-call, starting prices, and an estimate form for a new Michiana lawn care and leaf cleanup business.

- **RankRadius (`https://rankradius.io`):** Local SEO SaaS platform built and operated by Joe Hollenbach for field-service businesses.
- **HSC Portal (`https://github.com/justjoe19/HSC_Portal`):** Full-stack healthcare scheduling platform with role-based portals for patients, providers, and administrators.
